theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics

theses.dissent: Momentum leadership could be an attention peak that mean-reverts sharply; the absolute-trend gate has failed to protect drawdown in this market historically.

theses.dissent: High breadth may reflect late-cycle participation; the momentum lens has zero forward alpha, so any rally could stall once inflows slow.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors score drops below eligibility threshold or breadth contracts below 0.6.

theses.dissent: Pharma's high breadth (1.0) and durable trend could sustain outperformance even with elevated crowding; historically, trends can persist in crowded names.

falsifier.text: Crowding z drops below 0.5 AND score rises above 1.0, signaling a refined entry.
